'''Michael Carr''' (also known as Mike Carr; forum handle '''mc9457''') served as Tournament Support Advocate of the [[Players Committee]].

A PC news item archived on 13 October 2004 introduced him as the new Tournaments Advocate. He described himself as a tournament director for Pennsylvania and a member of Shadow Squadron, and said his short-term work would be Worlds 2005 and its qualifying season with [[Nick Kolnik]], with a new ratings system as a longer-term goal.<ref name="carr">[https://web.archive.org/web/20041013013300/http://swccgpc.com:80/News/MikeBio.htm Meet Michael Carr, New Tournaments Advocate!], swccgpc.com (Wayback, 13 October 2004)</ref>
